principle: A canonical Work does not require the source PDF/full-text asset to be downloaded into this repository. Canonical identity, provenance, rights, source identifiers and a stable delivery reference are sufficient for admission when the source permits remote reading/display/linking.

deliveryModes.use: Preferred when the source exposes a stable web reader/item page that can be opened or embedded under its terms.
Use when a stable rights-cleared PDF/image/text asset URL can be delivered directly without local mirroring.
Use when the source exposes IIIF manifest/canvas/image services; store the manifest identity and render remotely.
Use when remote embedding/direct asset delivery is unavailable but the canonical Work can still display normalized metadata, cover/preview when permitted, provenance and a source/read link.
Optional resilience/performance mode only when rights and operational need justify storing a local copy; never a prerequisite for canonical admission.

canonicalWorkMinimum: source institution and stable item identifier
assetRule: Do not block Chinese collection growth on downloading PDFs. Resolve exact source item/asset identity and choose the least duplicative valid delivery mode. Download/mirror only when necessary for reliability, transformation, offline processing or source fragility and when rights permit.
rightsRule: Public-domain status does not automatically imply that every host asset may be hotlinked or embedded. Record work copyright/public-domain status separately from host delivery/access terms.
clscApplication: For the current 11 CLSC candidates, the next pass should resolve each Yale/HKBU item identifier and available reader/download/asset endpoint. Eligible works may become canonical 黎明書局 works using remote-first delivery; local PDF storage is optional.
bibleWorldBoundary: The same remote-first mechanism can serve bible-world-zh resources in Emmaus, but those resources remain outside 黎明書局 Chinese collection counts.
